note: The private half of tests/data/original_maps_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the six original maps that the site serves for the Map Maker's 'Start from a game map' and of the words that the editor says when a map does not come, for tools/mutate.py (docs/WORKFLOW.md, 'Mutation checks'). Run from the checkout with a built ants_server: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/original_maps_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1. Every mutant must be caught: each breaks one rule of docs/SERVER.md ('The site's nginx') or docs/MAP_EDITOR.md (mapmaker_store.js, fetchMap, and the note of mapmaker_dialog.js). No mutant changes a map of the library: the files they change are the Dockerfile, docker/nginx.conf and the editor's scripts.
